'''New Republic Senate Resolution 54.325''' maintained the illegality of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], upholding the enforcement the [[Rights of Sentience]] of the [[Galactic Constitution]], by setting specific penalties such as for slave ownership and trafficking.
